column1: 02 — SYSTEM, EQUIPMENT & RELATIONSHIPS — Describe the whole, physical constituents, separate connections, reporting participant and hosting context.

column7:
[COMMON CANDIDATE] RELATED: IDTA-01001 Part1 Metamodel 3.2.0 (July 2026): One AAS digitally represents one asset, which may be physical or software. Submodels describe aspects of the asset rather than observed physical parts of a sensing installation. Original source IDs: AAS02-N001, AAS02-N002, AAS02-N003, AAS02-N005, AAS02-N007, AAS02-N011, AAS02-N017. BOUNDED PARTIAL research; not a mandatory DIM field/class, CSAPI Profile SHALL, AAS conformance or verified installed AAS record.
AAS03: RELATED: AAS v3.2 — Submodels organize aspects of one represented asset; collections group named values and lists group typed elements. These information structures do not establish a physical sensing-system hierarchy. [AAS03-N001, AAS03-N002, AAS03-N003, AAS03-N015, AAS03-N016]
AAS05: RELATED — JSON/XML require shell assetInformation; that digital record may represent a physical or software asset, not proof of an installed sensing System or CSAPI URI. [AAS05-S001, AAS05-S009]
AAS06: RELATED — Repository returns a digital Asset Administration Shell and registry returns its descriptor; neither proves a real sensing arrangement or that the descriptor is more authoritative than the shell. [AAS06-N003, AAS06-N011, AAS06-N013]
AAS09: RELATED — Hierarchy, technical-data and capability templates describe an asset at type or instance level and may represent designs or requirements. Their combined information does not select a universal sensing-System root class. [AAS09-N001, AAS09-N014, AAS09-N023, AAS09-N036]
column8: RELATED: BSI Annex C describes an optional separately registered middleware Node participating in a SAPIENT network; neither the middleware nor the detected-object taxonomy defines one physical whole sensing assembly. [SAP06-N14,SAP06-N19]
column9: [SPECIALIZED CANDIDATE] PARTIAL: A Composition Interface Component (CIC) exposes a composition of members through an ISA interface. The optional architecture-specific integration arrangement is useful specialized information; it does not establish one physical assembly or a universal root. [ISA21:S06-R005; F3-02]
column10: PARTIAL/RELATED: C239 §4.1 SOSA Sensor bounds physical sensing hardware and may contain several modalities; System/Subsystem roles depend on context. 3U/6U PIC, chassis and RTE are specialized implementations, not one common DIM root. The 2022 DSDM Sensor/SensorComponent association is separate lineage, not verified C239 native equivalence. [SOSA-D/G2-4A/G2-6A–6D/G2-7T/G3-N2]

column7: [SPECIALIZED CANDIDATE] AAS06: RELATED — A technology-specific AAS API service or endpoint is a network participant, but it is not automatically a network-visible physical sensor or participating hardware. [AAS06-N001, AAS06-N020, AAS06-N036]
column8: [COMMON CANDIDATE] RELATED: A SAPIENT Node is an identified architecture participant; optional middleware can also register as a Node. Useful network-participant identity does not require a one-to-one correspondence with physical sensing hardware. [SAP02-N02, SAP02-N03, SAP03A-N03, SAP03A-N04, SAP06-N14]
column9: [COMMON CANDIDATE] PARTIAL: An ISA component or Controller is an interface-conformant network participant or service role. Describing the participant role is a common need; neither a physical sensor nor the original observation performer follows from network visibility. [ISA21:S06-R006; F3-02]
column10: RELATED, with NO_ESTABLISHED identity equivalence: C239 §§5.8, 12–15 describe module interactions, logging roles, backplane planes, Ethernet/fiber and runtime network access. These are design interfaces or scoped endpoints, not necessarily independently discoverable IP/CSAPI Systems, real network participants, or observed live services. [SOSA-D/G2-4A/G2-5/G2-6A/G2-7A–7S]
